confidenceVoteCites.quote: The Knesset voted 89-18 to approve the new government.

reconciliation.note: 97 formal member seats, with only 37 of Alignment’s 44 included (six Mapam MKs and Yossi Sarid excluded). Recorded vote 89–18 leaves 13 non-voters. Their individual membership/absence distribution is not recovered; 97 must not be rendered as 89. Quantified gap: 97 identified member/support seats versus 89 votes for (+8); the named abstainers, absentees or dissenters needed to explain this gap have not been recovered. Do not infer that each member voted for.
